[1mDescription[22m:
Install, launch, and inspect apps

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli app[22m <command> [options]

[1mCommands[22m:
  [1mbundle[22m                 Verify AssetBundle packaging in APK files
  [1minfo <package>[22m         Show information for an installed app on the preferred current device
  [1minstall <path>[22m         Install an APK to the preferred current device
  [1mlaunch <package>[22m       Launch an app on the preferred current device
  [1mlist[22m
